constraint_decided_it: Nothing in the model separated them: both reach the modelling the CRM prescribes (P22/P23/P24 are declared E8->E39/E39/E18 at event level with many-to-many quantification and no per-object actor pairing, and E8's scope note transfers title 'from one or more instances of E39 Actor to one or more other instances of E39 Actor' -- v7.3.2's E96 sharpens 'other' to 'different' -- so one E8 cannot carry both societies on both sides; P9 consists of is E4->E4 and E8 is E7 < E5 < E4, so it holds between the two Acquisitions). They were separated by evidence: B attributes the t1224 sentence 'P9 is sufficient for asserting that the different activities are part of the overall [Exchange]' to Martin Doerr and says the two-Acquisition-plus-P9 construction is 'exactly the construction Martin Doerr argued for'; the sentence is Robert Sanderson's, in message [1], the proposal for the new Exchange class, and Doerr's reply (message [2]) never mentions P9 and offers 'a two-stage process or multiple instantiation' instead.
reasoning: Both answers give the same construction -- Acquisition-1 P23=Society A / P22=Society B / P24=tokens, Acquisition-2 P23=Society B / P22=Society A / P24=medals, grouped by P9 consists of under an enclosing activity -- and both correctly exclude E96 Purchase on its scope-note requirement that the transferring party be 'completely compensated by the payment of a monetary amount'. Every quotation A gives verifies: the E96 scope-note decomposition line is exact in `concept E96`, the 'Exx Purchase ... overall transaction' draft wording is in t0914 msg [1] (Doerr), and Krause in t0914 msg [3] does list 'exchange of objects' as a non-monetary trigger of E8 Acquisition while rejecting the money restriction. B's central archive claim is a speaker misattribution of a real quote plus a claim Doerr endorsed a mechanism he never addressed, which is `unsupported` even though B's conclusion is right; B also calls Issue 420 CRMsoc-only when the register lists it under 'CIDOC CRM, CRMsoc'. B is marginally cleaner on the umbrella (a plain E7 Activity, where A hedges 'parent E8 Acquisition (or plain E7 Activity)' and a parent E8 would reintroduce the very direction ambiguity A rejects, though E96's scope note sanctions the same-class parent), so the margin is slight.
